tasks.short: Update the verified client address and meter location

steps.what: Verify the client's address correction against the authorised request and service-point identity; resolve whether the change concerns a contact address or the physical service address.
Inspect or confirm the actual meter location and identifier at the service point, noting access and location details without substituting a map guess for observation.
Locate the matching client and meter records in the utility field-service system {OTHER}; configure its native service-point lookup and linked-record view to avoid repeated searches.
outputs: matched current client and meter records

steps.what: Draft the address and meter-location updates using native linked fields in the utility field-service system {OTHER}; compare the completed before-and-after record with the verified corrections and check the exact target IDs.
inputs: matched current client and meter records
outputs: checked final address and location update

steps.what: Commit the exact checked address and location update to the authorised client and meter fields in the utility field-service system {OTHER}.
inputs: checked final address and location update
outputs: updated client address and meter location

tasks.design: Configure the native service-point lookup and linked update form in the utility field-service system {OTHER}. The meter reader verifies the client's address and actual meter location, checks the complete proposed changes and commits them within existing permissions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated client and meter searches and field entry obscured the common service-point reference.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked-record views can expose the matching records and reuse explicit verified fields.
tasks.still_hard: A contact-address change is not necessarily a changed service location, and meter access information can be wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a mismatched customer, service point or physical meter before altering the record.

ambition.what: No authority to change contracts or service ownership.

tasks.altitude: Less record navigation and repeated field entry; physical verification remains.

reach.task: Verify a service or delivery location
reach.learn: Distinguishing contact addresses from physical access instructions.

evidence.claim: Native field-service record views can use a service-point key to retrieve linked meter and client fields.

assumptions: Boundary is an authorised address and location correction through the saved fields. Contract transfer, billing-account ownership and external notification are separate unchanged processes. Shares are an illustrative scenario.

The meter reader captures client ID, service-point ID, meter serial, correction source, address type, address components, actual location and access note in s1-s2. Current master records are existing inputs. Manual entry and investigation remain counted when identifiers or linked fields are missing; no geocoding inference replaces the physical location check.
Native linked forms are tested before custom integration. Savings apply only to repeated lookup and field assembly; actual verification and first capture remain fully counted.

The ordinary author check in s4 binds the completed before-and-after update and target record IDs for s5. An edit invalidates approval. Each change remains within the meter reader's existing field permissions.
unknowns: Which address and location fields meter readers may update
research_questions: Can the existing field app show exact target records and address types before save?

already_counted.description: Check retrieved records and completed address and location changes.

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and check service-point lookup after system changes.

approvals.approved_version: Final address and location field changes and target IDs checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Linked lookup saves 8 hours and field assembly 11.9 hours per 100 baseline hours, less 2 upkeep: 17.9 net. Zero if native linkage is already used. Physical and client verification and same-system commit retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the assigned past-due bills and current payment status in the utility billing and field-collection system {OTHER}; configure its native current-balance view to replace repeated cross-screen lookup, checking account and dispute flags.
Contact the customer about the verified past-due bill, explain the balance and available authorised payment process, and refer disputes or hardship requests through the existing process.
Receive and verify the actual payment using the existing authorised collection method; do not mark a promise to pay as money received.
Prepare and check the actual payment entry and ordinary receipt in the utility collection system {OTHER}, confirming payer, bill allocation, amount, payment reference and customer recipient.
outputs: checked final payment entry and receipt

steps.what: Commit the checked actual payment entry and its receipt version in the utility collection system {OTHER}.
inputs: checked final payment entry and receipt

steps.what: Give the exact checked receipt to the customer through the existing utility collection system {OTHER} receipt channel.

tasks.design: Configure the native current-balance and dispute view in the utility billing and field-collection system {OTHER}. Customer discussion, actual payment handling and existing payment-and-receipt preparation remain human work, with separate checked commit and receipt delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Collection staff repeatedly navigated bill and payment screens to establish the current balance.
tasks.enabler_now: Native account views can bring existing bill, payment and dispute records together.
tasks.still_hard: A customer may dispute the bill, have already paid or need support the meter reader cannot authorise.
tasks.human_edge: Handle the conversation respectfully and recognise when collection should be referred to the responsible team.

ambition.what: No new debt enforcement, payment-plan or service-disconnection authority.

tasks.altitude: Less balance lookup; the meter reader's authorised collection duties remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Accurate account references and dispute handoff.

evidence.claim: Native utility billing views can show existing balances, payments and dispute flags without automating customer negotiation.

assumptions: This task applies only where meter readers already have an authorised payment-collection duty and receipt process. Boundary ends at the recorded payment and delivered receipt; reconciliation and unresolved debt follow-up remain separate. Shares are illustrative.

Existing billing processes supply account ID, bill ID, due amount, due date, payment status and dispute flag. The meter reader checks these in s1 and captures actual amount, method, received time, payment reference and receipt recipient in s3-s4. Manual capture and clarification remain counted; an appointment or promise never becomes a completed payment.

Test native account views first. Only repeated navigation loses time. Physical payment handling, customer effort, actual record writing and receipt work remain unchanged; no new collection or reminder message is introduced.

The ordinary payment-and-receipt check in s4 binds the completed entry and receipt version for s5-s6. Edits void both approvals. Native posting and receipt delivery retain their full one-hour shares, not a claimed transport saving.
unknowns: Whether this role collects payments in the organisation
Existing account-view use and receipt method
research_questions: Can the native view show sufficiently current payments and dispute flags for a collection visit?

already_counted.description: Verify current balance, account and dispute flags in the native view.

incremental.description: Check account-view mappings and freshness after billing changes.

approvals.approved_version: Actual payment entry and receipt checked at the end of s4
Same final receipt and customer recipient checked at the end of s4, unchanged by s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native balance lookup removes 30% of the 20-hour lookup share: 6 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero if already configured or the view is not current enough. Discussion, payment handling, record writing, commit and receipt delivery retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Meter readers keep physical verification and authorised customer duties while native linked views reduce repeated lookup.
reach: Improve location references with cargo and freight agents
Improve dispute routing with telephone operators
role.ambitious_version: Keep utility location and collection records accurate without extending the meter reader's spending, contract or enforcement authority.
